mentions.name: BlockViz
mentions.description: A crypto market visualization and simulation tool that runs 'what-if' scenarios directly on historical data. It lets users simulate rotating from one coin into another and back again over a chosen period, or selling part of a position and buying back later after a drawdown, to see whether such trades would actually have improved outcomes. Includes a coin flip simulation and a sell & buy-back simulation.
mentions.problem: TradingView is great for charts, but it is hard to answer simple 'what-if' questions about crypto trades — such as whether rotating into another coin would have helped, or whether trimming and buying back improved outcomes or just felt good in hindsight.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been building a crypto market visualization and simulation tool because I kept running into the same problem:
TradingView is great for charts, but it’s hard to answer simple “what-if” questions like would rotating into another coin actually have helped or did trimming and buying back improve outcomes, or just feel good in hindsight.
